title: Install a Baseline Package Set (RHEL/Rocky or Debian, offline-repo aware)
description: Installs a list of packages using dnf/yum on RHEL/Rocky or apt on Debian, assuming an airgapped box already has a local/offline repo mirror configured -- this script never reaches out to the internet itself.

toggles.name: REFRESH_CACHE
toggles.prompt: Refresh the local repo metadata cache first (needs your offline repo mirror reachable, not the internet)
